lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar, at ease in his palace, has a frightening dream and calls all Babylon's wise men.
Daniel, called Belteshazzar, comes in last, and the king says the spirit of the holy gods is in him.
A watcher from heaven orders the dream tree cut down, and the man must graze until forty days pass.
Daniel, perplexed, tells the king that the great tree in the dream is the king himself.
Twelve months later, a voice from heaven ends the boasting king's reign, and he eats grass like a lion.
